10.sourceTitle: Schwalbe Clik Valve retrofit kit, SV / DV valves become SCV
10.evidenceText: Multiple prices found across two sources: €4.50, €5.99, €4.90, €5.99, €9.99, €11.99 (ebike24.com) and €23.90, €16.99, €5.95, €3.79, €16.95, €9.99, €13.95, €8.99 (bike-discount.de). Median of all 13 retail prices = €9.99
10.extractionRationale: Extracted median price from all retail prices found across both sources. Source 1 lists multiple Schwalbe Clik products with sale and regular prices. Source 2 shows current prices and RRP values. The median of all 13 identified prices (€3.79, €4.50, €4.90, €5.95, €5.99, €8.99, €9.99, €9.99, €11.99, €13.95, €16.95, €16.99, €23.90) is €9.99.

27.extractionRationale: Counted unique CoreCap valve product page URLs excluding accessories. The three BTI-166 valve listings have different product IDs (p1993547, p1993551, p1993549) representing distinct product pages. The BTI-165 Ventilkern entries (p1993585, p1993582) are replacement valve cores/accessories and excluded per task instructions.

36.evidenceText: The pump head adapter (item 3526) can be integrated into the pump head of current pumps. The Clik Valve can also be inflated with normal SV (Presta) pumps - thanks to this reverse compatibility.
36.extractionRationale: The source describes product features and compatibility details but does not provide explicit data on the percentage or fraction of Clik valve product pages that display accessories in 'frequently bought together' or 'related products' sections. No quantitative attach rate metric is stated in the evidence.

37.evidenceText: The provided content discusses pump head adapters and dust cap removal but does not list specific replacement/spare part SKUs such as valve cores, seals, o-rings, or replacement kits with counts.
37.extractionRationale: The evidence does not contain a specific count or listing of distinct replacement/spare part SKUs for the Clik Valve. The page mentions conversion kits exist but provides no detailed inventory or SKU count data.

45.evidenceText: All DT Swiss wheelsets are tubeless compatible and come tubeless ready, equipped with tubeless tape and valves. [No mention of Clik valve or 2026/2027 product lines]
45.extractionRationale: The provided evidence from DT Swiss product pages mentions generic tubeless valves but contains no specific references to Clik valve adoption in 2026 or 2027 product lines, nor any information about other major brands (Mavic, Hunt, Zipp, ENVE, Roval). With no evidence of Clik adoption by any of the six major brands specified, the percentage is 0%.

49.evidenceText: Clik valve, Rear: Schwalbe G-One R, Perfomance, RaceGuard, TLR, Addix, 45-622 Tube: Schwalbe SCV17, Clik valve.
49.extractionRationale: Evidence shows "Clik valve" mentioned in Source 1 as a tire/tube valve specification, but the exact count of individual bicycle models featuring this valve type cannot be precisely determined from the provided excerpt. Sources 2-4 reference "Herrmans Clik" which is a grip product, not a valve. The precise model count matching the query cannot be reliably extracted from this evidence.

50.evidenceText: Evidence shows two distinct dedicated Clik Valve pages: (1) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/clik-valve with installation instructions for DV and SV valves, and (2) https://www.schwalbe.com/en/technology-faq/valve which is a FAQ page about bike tire valves including Clik Valve. Other URLs are either homepage, unrelated products (Airmax), or accessibility pages.
50.extractionRationale: Counted only pages that are specifically dedicated technical documents, installation guides, or FAQ pages about Clik Valve. The main Clik Valve page contains installation instructions. The technology-faq/valve page is explicitly a FAQ resource. The homepage, Airmax product page, and accessibility page do not qualify as dedicated Clik Valve technical resources despite mentioning the product.
